summary: U Me Aur Hum ("You, Me and Us") is a 2008 Indian romantic drama produced and directed by Ajay Devgan under Ajay Devgan Films and Eros International. It is Devgan's first film as a director and his seventh film with his wife Kajol. The note also says the film was released on 11 April 2008 in around 450 cinemas and that it is plagiarized from the 2004 film The Notebook.
one_line: A 2008 Indian romantic drama directed by Ajay Devgan, starring Devgan and Kajol, released April 2008 and said to be plagiarized from The Notebook.
key_facts: U Me Aur Hum ("You, Me and Us") is a 2008 Indian romantic drama film.
U Me Aur Hum was produced and directed by Ajay Devgan under Ajay Devgan Films and Eros International.
U Me Aur Hum is Ajay Devgan's first film as a director.
Ajay Devgan stars in U Me Aur Hum alongside his wife Kajol in their seventh film together.
Karan Khanna, Isha Sharvani, Sumeet Raghavan and Divya Dutta also star in U Me Aur Hum.
U Me Aur Hum was written by Ajay Devgan and three other writers.
U Me Aur Hum was released on 11 April 2008.
U Me Aur Hum was released in around 450 cinemas, with 150 of them being digital screens.
The note states that U Me Aur Hum is plagiarized from the similar 2004 film The Notebook.
